Source counter: page claims 1785 total shipments; rows actually visible on the free page = 5 (4 export rows + 1 import row of CornerMax sleeves from I I SLING INC., HS 59090090, B/L 7604424). domestic_evidence: Domestic supply is evidenced by named Indian OEM customers with delivery/quality statements on the company's own site (https://www.kryfs.com/), quoted verbatim: "The Supplies of core laminations by KRYFS were in line with the required quality standards and deliveries were made on time. KRYFS has been executing various orders over the last six years and we are satisfied with their overall performance." — Sarvesh Chaturvedi, General Manager (TCB - P & MM), Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited, Bhopal. Also quoted: "The step - lap cores procured from KRYFS has given us substantial savings" — P. S. Asrani, Executive Director, Rima Transformers & Conductors Pvt. Ltd.; and "KRYFS has developed special die and fixture to cut laminations as per our design requirement" — Sushil K., Deputy Manager Materials, Crompton Greaves Ltd. Manufacturing base confirmed: "manufacturing capacity of over 50,000 MT per year" of CRGO laminations. GST turnover band: not public on the pages read — null. GeM/CPPP tender rows: not retrieved (search engine returned connection errors; Google blocked with HTTP 429) — null.
note: Manufacturer (not a trader): own plant converting 50,000 MT/yr of CRGO electrical steel into transformer laminations and cores, in business since 1992, registered address AZA HOUSE, 3RD FLOOR, 24 TURNER ROAD, BANDRA (WEST), Mumbai. Export activity is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination and HS code, latest 2026-02-28 to Port Kelang (Malaysia), plus Oman, Egypt and USA lanes, all under HS 85049010 — consistent with the declared HS 850490. Domestic supply is also factually supported by named Indian buyers (BHEL Bhopal, Crompton Greaves, Bharat Bijlee, Rima Transformers) giving delivery-performance statements, though these are customer testimonials on the vendor's own site rather than independent GST or tender records. Revenue figure and GST turnover band are not public in the sources read — recorded as null, not estimated. No sanctions/court/ownership issues were assessed here (out of scope for this role). Verdict basis: real shipments exist on both export and domestic sides; no grounds for rejection.
